data.claim: Multiple Los Angeles-area outlets independently agree that Jonathan Castelan, 18, was arrested and charged with murder, attempted murder and assault with a deadly weapon in connection with a July 10, 2026 El Monte stabbing; court-record-based reporting also records a not-guilty plea and pending proceedings.
data.limitations: Records arrest, charges and reported plea status, not guilt. Victim identities omitted from normalized claim.
